title: Erros por ~30 min durante um rollout: pods antigos e novos juntos esgotaram as conexões do Postgres
what_it_tests: Explicar um incidente já resolvido (pedido de RCA), correlacionando janela do erro com a janela do rollout.

ticket.subject: Errors for about 30 minutes this afternoon, now fine. Customer wants an RCA
ticket.description: Customer Stark Industries saw 'internal server error' on most GraphQL requests between roughly 17:10 and 17:40 UTC. It recovered on its own. They are asking for a root cause analysis. Service: acme/graph-api.

related_tickets.subject: Slow GraphQL queries on large projects
related_tickets.resolution: Added a missing index on project_items. Unrelated to connection errors.

deploys.message: deploy: scale graph-api to 24 replicas with maxSurge 100%
deploys.author: Lena

logs.message: rollout: 48 pods running (24 old + 24 new) during surge
FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
db pool: waited 5000ms for a connection, pool size=20 per pod
rollout complete: 24 pods running, db connections 480/500

ground_truth.root_cause: During the rollout from 61c0b3e (24 replicas, maxSurge 100%), old and new pods ran at the same time: 48 pods with 20 connections each exceeded Postgres max_connections, so new connections were refused until the surge finished. Lower maxSurge or the per-pod pool size, or put PgBouncer in front of Postgres.
